findings.evidence: `Quiver.IsAcyclic.exists_isSinkAdmissible` (Admissible.lean:244) supplies `⟨l, hnd, hall, hl⟩` from `IsAcyclic` alone; the sibling result `titsForm_dimVector_indecProjRep_of_isAcyclic` (Projective/Acyclic.lean:52) is already stated instance-style with an `IsAcyclic` hypothesis, and the roadmap target `dimVector_isRoot_iff` (roadmap Suggested.lean:275-279) has instance-style quiver arguments and no list.
findings.fix: State the consumer-facing form in instance style with acyclicity, discharging the ordering internally: `theorem ... [Quiver Q] [Fintype Q] [∀ a b, Fintype (a ⟶ b)] (hac : Quiver.IsAcyclic Q) (hpd : (titsForm Q).PosDef) (M) (hM : Indecomposable M) (hfd : IsFinDim k Q M) : titsForm Q (fun j ↦ (dimVector M j : ℤ)) = 1`, proved by `obtain ⟨l, hnd, hall, hl⟩ := hac.exists_isSinkAdmissible` and the present theorem. Keep the ordering-explicit version if wanted, but the list-free one is the level the milestone consumes.
findings.issue: `titsForm_dimVector_eq_one_of_indecomposable` concludes `titsForm q (dim M) = 1`, which mentions neither `l` nor the reflected quiver, yet forces the caller to supply `l`, `hnd`, `hall`, `hl` and the explicit `q`/`hq` arguments. The ordering is an artefact of the proof, not of the statement — unlike `coxeterFunctor` and `exists_vertexPreReflectionList_pow_apply_neg`, whose conclusions do depend on the word.

findings.evidence: Root.lean:212-216 derives it from `hM.1` and `isZero_of_dimVector_eq_zero` alone; `grep -n 'dimVector_ne_zero\|dimVector.*≠ 0' TauCeti/` returns only this inline `have`.
findings.fix: Extract it as a public lemma with only the hypotheses it uses — e.g. `dimVector_ne_zero_of_indecomposable {M} (hfd : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj ((Paths.of Q).obj i))) (hM : Indecomposable M) : dimVector M ≠ 0`, next to `isZero_of_dimVector_eq_zero` in DimensionVector.lean — and use it here, so consumers get `d ≠ 0 ∧ titsForm d = 1` rather than only the second conjunct.
findings.issue: `hd0`, that a pointwise finite-dimensional indecomposable has nonzero dimension vector, is proved inline inside `exists_isZero_coxeterFunctor_iterate`, i.e. under `hpd`, `hnd`, `hall`, `hl` — none of which it needs. It is the second half of the file's advertised "positive root" claim (Root.lean:20-22, 256-257) and nothing exports it.

summary: The stagewise lemmas sit at the right level, but the user-facing theorem is stated below it: its conclusion never mentions the sink-admissible ordering, yet callers must construct one, and the general nonvanishing of the dimension vector is buried as an inline `have` inside a positive-definiteness proof.
